prompt: A small fast courier aircraft, much-patched: a short stubby fuselage with a bubble cockpit canopy, a pointed nose with a probe antenna, straight wings, two large ducted fans in round cowled nacelles slung under the wings, a tall swept tail fin with a long ribbon pennant streaming back from its tip, and a boxy cargo pod clamped under the belly. Faded orange and cream patchwork paint, riveted panels. A lived-in space-opera bush plane seen from the front three-quarter. Isolated 3D model render on a plain uniform medium-grey studio background, the whole object fully in frame with generous margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no lettering, no logos, no people. Crisp hard-surface modelling with bold, clearly separated parts and a strong readable silhouette: chunky forms and clean edges, no clutter, no hanging moss, no dangling wires.
